title: Image of God
definition: The image of God is the truth that human beings were uniquely created by God to reflect His character, represent His rule, and live in relationship with Him.
summary: Every human being has dignity and worth because humanity was created in God's image.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the perfect image of God, and through Him believers are being renewed into the image God intended.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Human beings are not accidents or mere animals. They are uniquely created in the image of God. This gives every person dignity, value, accountability, and purpose.

The image of God includes humanity's calling to reflect God's character, represent His rule, live in relationship, create, serve, and exercise stewardship. Sin has deeply damaged humanity, but it has not erased the image.

Christ is the perfect image of God. Through salvation, God renews believers so they increasingly reflect Christ in holiness, truth, love, and obedience.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people measure worth by ability, appearance, productivity, health, status, or past failure. The image of God matters because it grounds human dignity in God's creation, not human performance.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Treat every person, including the weak, disabled, unborn, elderly, addicted, grieving, or difficult, as someone with God-given dignity. Ask Christ to renew His image in how you think, speak, and act.
